from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for a single company from a quarterly report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock code associated with the company, if available")
    operating_revenue: float = Field(description="Operating revenue amount for the quarter (in CNY)")
    net_profit: float = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders for the quarter (in CNY)")
    operating_cash_flow: float = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities for the quarter (in CNY)")
    report_period: str = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2025-Q1'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container for all parsed financial records."""
    records: list[FinancialRecord] = Field(description="List of financial records from all documents")
